description: This file defines the VirtualInput class and related nested classes and interfaces for handling virtual input devices, key mappings, and input event processing within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes class declarations, enums, and method signatures for managing input events, key mappings, and IPC communication.

classes.name: VirtualInput
classes.description: Abstract base class for virtual input device handling, including key mapping, event dispatching, and IPC communication within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: VirtualInput::RepeatKeyTimer
classes.description: Handles timing for repeated key events, including scheduling, resetting, and dispatching repeated key presses.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap
classes.description: Manages key code to key mapping, including import/export, pass-through mode, and change notifications.

classes.name: VirtualInput::KeyMap::KeyMapEntry
classes.description: Represents a single key mapping entry with code, key, and modifiers.

classes.name: VirtualInput::PostLookupTable
classes.description: Represents a table for post-processing key lookup conversions, including nested conversion entries.

classes.name: VirtualInput::InputDataLink
classes.description: Handles IPC communication for input data, including enabling/disabling, subscription, and keycode conversion.

classes.name: VirtualInput::VirtualInputChannelServer
classes.description: IPC channel server for managing IPC clients related to virtual input.

classes.name: VirtualInput::IPCUserInput
classes.description: Implements virtual input handling via IPC, including managing input consumers, event dispatch, and post-lookup processing.

classes.name: VirtualInput::InputHandler
classes.description: Manages initialization and deinitialization of input devices, supporting device and virtual modes.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::AddReference
methods.description: Adds a reference to the repeat key timer, scheduling the timer.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::DropReference
methods.description: Drops the reference, resets, and revokes the scheduled job.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::Interval
methods.description: Sets the start and interval times for key repetition.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::Arm
methods.description: Arms the timer with a specific key code for repeated key events.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::Reset
methods.description: Resets the timer and returns the current code.

methods.name: RepeatKeyTimer::Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a repeated key event if active.

methods.name: KeyMap::PassThrough
methods.description: Enables or disables pass-through mode for key mapping.

methods.name: KeyMap::Import
methods.description: Imports key mappings from a JSON array.

methods.name: KeyMap::Export
methods.description: Exports key mappings to a JSON array.

methods.name: KeyMap::Add
methods.description: Adds a new key mapping entry.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Consumers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over input consumers.

methods.name: VirtualInput::KeyEvent
methods.description: Processes a key press or release event.

methods.name: VirtualInput::PostLookup
methods.description: Loads post-lookup conversion tables from files.

methods.name: VirtualInput::FindPostLookup
methods.description: Finds a post-lookup table by name.

methods.name: VirtualInput::Send
methods.description: Sends key, mouse, or touch data events.
